description:
Live Google results for any keyword in a country: the organic top 10–30 (position, domain, URL, title, snippet), whether an AI Overview shows and which domains it cites, the featured snippet owner, People Also Ask questions and the SERP features present.

Billing: 5¢ per call. Not billed when nothing comes back or the call fails; the same call again within 24h is free. On the no-account server, a caller without credit gets one data call a day free.

Inputs:
  keyword — the search query.
  country — ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR); default US.
  results — 10–30, default 10.
  device — desktop (default) | mobile.

Returns { keyword, country, device, checked_at, ai_overview: {present, cited_domains}, featured_snippet_owner, people_also_ask, serp_features, results: [{position, domain, url, title, description}], google_url, cached, charged_cents }.

Example: { keyword: "best crm for small business", country: "US" }

country.description: Google market, ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR). Default US.
